ex.en: He always comes to show his appreciation during the New Year and holidays.
ex.zh: 每逢過年過節，他總會來表達謝意。

ex.en: Please accept this gift as a token of our appreciation.
ex.zh: 請收下這份禮物，聊表我們的謝意。

ex.en: She has a deep appreciation of classical music.
ex.zh: 她非常懂得欣賞古典音樂。

ex.en: The course gave me a better appreciation of art.
ex.zh: 這門課讓我更懂得欣賞藝術。

ex.en: The appreciation of the yen hurt exports.
ex.zh: 日圓升值打擊了出口。

ex.en: Property appreciation has slowed this year.
ex.zh: 今年房地產增值的速度放緩了。

ex.en: You owe me an apology for that.
ex.zh: 關於那件事你欠我一個道歉。

ex.en: I must make an apology to her.
ex.zh: 我得向她道歉。

ex.en: Please accept my sincere apologies.
ex.zh: 請接受我誠摯的歉意。

ex.en: He worked as an apprentice to a carpenter.
ex.zh: 他在一位木匠手下當學徒。

ex.en: The company hires five apprentices every year.
ex.zh: 公司每年招收五名學徒。

ex.en: She was apprenticed to a famous chef.
ex.zh: 她拜一位名廚為師當學徒。

ex.en: He apprenticed with a local electrician.
ex.zh: 他跟著當地一位電工當學徒。

ex.en: Which do you like best, apples, oranges or grapes?
ex.zh: 蘋果、橘子和葡萄，你最喜歡哪一種？

ex.en: How many apples do you want me to buy?
ex.zh: 你要我買幾顆蘋果？

ex.en: Some of the apples in the box were rotten.
ex.zh: 盒子裡有些蘋果爛了。

apple.zh: the apple doesn't fall far from the tree：有其父（母）必有其子

ex.en: The apple does not fall far from the tree.
ex.zh: 有其父必有其子。

ex.en: She became a doctor like her mom; the apple doesn't fall far from the tree.
ex.zh: 她跟媽媽一樣當了醫生，真是有其母必有其女。

ex.en: This law is applicable to all cases.
ex.zh: 這條法律適用於所有情況。

ex.en: This discount is not applicable to sale items.
ex.zh: 這項折扣不適用於特價商品。

ex.en: Please fill in all applicable fields.
ex.zh: 請填寫所有適用的欄位。

ex.en: See the appendix for more details.
ex.zh: 更多細節請見附錄。

ex.en: The data is in Appendix B.
ex.zh: 資料在附錄 B。

ex.en: He had his appendix removed last year.
ex.zh: 他去年割了盲腸。

ex.en: The doctor said Tom's appendix was inflamed.
ex.zh: 醫生說湯姆的闌尾發炎了。

ex.en: This is all very approximate.
ex.zh: 這些全都只是很粗略的估計。

ex.en: The approximate cost is 5,000 dollars.
ex.zh: 大約的費用是五千元。

ex.en: Can you give me an approximate arrival time?
ex.zh: 可以告訴我大概幾點到嗎？

ex.en: The story approximates to historical truth.
ex.zh: 這個故事很接近歷史真相。

ex.en: The results approximate our predictions.
ex.zh: 結果和我們的預測很接近。

ex.en: I'm a little apprehensive about the job interview.
ex.zh: 我對這次工作面試有點不安。

ex.en: Many employees are apprehensive about the merger.
ex.zh: 許多員工對合併感到憂心。

ex.en: I have a good appetite today.
ex.zh: 我今天胃口很好。

ex.en: Thanks to you I've lost my appetite.
ex.zh: 托你的福，我一點胃口都沒了。

ex.en: The sight of fresh lobster gave me an appetite.
ex.zh: 看到新鮮的龍蝦，我就有了食慾。

ex.en: Algeria's appetite for sugar is increasing.
ex.zh: 阿爾及利亞對糖的需求正在增加。

ex.en: Investors have little appetite for risk right now.
ex.zh: 投資人目前不太願意承擔風險。

ex.en: Start behaving appropriately.
ex.zh: 請開始表現得體一點。

ex.en: Please dress appropriately for the interview.
ex.zh: 面試請穿著得體。

ex.en: The issue was handled appropriately.
ex.zh: 這個問題處理得很恰當。

ex.en: This figure is only an approximation.
ex.zh: 這個數字只是概略的估計。

ex.en: Can you give me a rough approximation of the cost?
ex.zh: 你能大概估算一下費用嗎？

ex.en: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.
ex.zh: 一艘船突然從霧中出現。

ex.en: She stopped appearing in public after her accident.
ex.zh: 那次意外之後，她就不再公開露面了。

ex.en: New programmes will appear in the fall on television.
ex.zh: 秋天電視上會有新節目。

ex.en: There appears to be a party in that house.
ex.zh: 那間房子裡好像在開派對。

ex.en: She appears to have a lot of friends.
ex.zh: 她好像有很多朋友。

ex.en: That's the best approach to the study of English.
ex.zh: 那是學英文最好的方法。

ex.en: We need a new approach to this problem.
ex.zh: 我們需要用新方法處理這個問題。

ex.en: I was dazzled by the headlights of an approaching car.
ex.zh: 迎面而來的車頭燈讓我眼花。

ex.en: The train slowed and blared its horn as it approached the railway crossing.
ex.zh: 火車快到平交道時減速並鳴笛。

ex.en: We should approach this problem from different angles.
ex.zh: 我們應該從不同角度處理這個問題。

ex.en: How should we approach the client about the delay?
ex.zh: 我們該怎麼跟客戶談延誤的事？

ex.en: Do you think it's appropriate to talk like that?
ex.zh: 你覺得那樣說話合適嗎？

ex.en: Local people can give appropriate advice.
ex.zh: 當地人可以給你適切的建議。

ex.en: I had to change clothes because what I was wearing wasn't appropriate for the situation.
ex.zh: 我得換衣服，因為我穿的不適合這個場合。

ex.en: His music and words appeal to young people.
ex.zh: 他的音樂和歌詞很吸引年輕人。

ex.en: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.
ex.zh: 私下說，湯姆的點子我不太感興趣。

ex.en: The new design should appeal to younger customers.
ex.zh: 新設計應該會吸引年輕顧客。

ex.en: Tom appealed to his mother to buy a new toy for him.
ex.zh: 湯姆央求媽媽買新玩具給他。

ex.en: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.
ex.zh: 被告將向上級法院上訴。

ex.en: The police appealed to the public for information.
ex.zh: 警方呼籲民眾提供線索。

ex.en: We made an appeal for support.
ex.zh: 我們發出了尋求支持的呼籲。

ex.en: The product has wide appeal among young people.
ex.zh: 這項產品廣受年輕人喜愛。

ex.en: Mr. and Mrs. Smith live apart from each other now.
ex.zh: 史密斯夫婦現在分居了。

ex.en: He is living apart from his wife.
ex.zh: 他和太太分居。

ex.en: The two offices are about five kilometers apart.
ex.zh: 這兩間辦公室相隔大約五公里。

ex.en: Apart from my sister, my family doesn't watch TV.
ex.zh: 除了我妹妹，我家人都不看電視。

ex.en: Apart from languages, I'm also interested in technology.
ex.zh: 除了語言，我也對科技有興趣。

ex.en: Apart from some fruit, he hasn't eaten anything.
ex.zh: 除了一些水果，他什麼都沒吃。

apart.zh: fall apart / take apart：解體、拆開

ex.en: My old shoes are falling apart.
ex.zh: 我的舊鞋快解體了。

ex.en: He took the computer apart to fix it.
ex.zh: 他把電腦拆開來修理。

ex.en: Tom has apparently done that already.
ex.zh: 湯姆好像已經做完了。

ex.en: Apparently, there is nothing that cannot happen today.
ex.zh: 看來如今沒有什麼事是不可能發生的。

ex.en: Apparently, the meeting has been canceled.
ex.zh: 聽說會議取消了。

ex.en: Judging from her appearance, I think that she's rich.
ex.zh: 從她的外表看來，我想她應該很有錢。

ex.en: Don't be fooled by appearances.
ex.zh: 不要被外表騙了。

ex.en: The two brothers are quite unlike in their appearance.
ex.zh: 這兩兄弟長得一點都不像。

ex.en: The singer made a surprise appearance at the event.
ex.zh: 那位歌手意外現身活動現場。

ex.en: It was his first public appearance since the accident.
ex.zh: 這是他自意外以來首度公開露面。

appearance.zh: keep up appearances：維持表面、撐場面

ex.en: She managed to keep up appearances.
ex.zh: 她努力維持表面上的體面。

ex.en: They kept up appearances even after the business failed.
ex.zh: 即使生意失敗了，他們還是維持表面的風光。

ex.en: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
ex.zh: 董事會一致決定任命她為執行長。

ex.en: He was appointed ambassador to Britain.
ex.zh: 他被任命為駐英國大使。

ex.en: They appointed him as a director.
ex.zh: 他們任命他為董事。

ex.en: He came five minutes behind the appointed time.
ex.zh: 他比約定的時間晚到了五分鐘。

ex.en: We met at the appointed place.
ex.zh: 我們在約定的地點碰面。

ex.en: It's in times like these that the character of a person becomes apparent.
ex.zh: 正是在這種時候，一個人的品格才會顯露出來。

ex.en: It soon became apparent that the plan wouldn't work.
ex.zh: 很快就看得出這個計畫行不通。

ex.en: Despite his apparent calm, he was very nervous.
ex.zh: 他表面上很冷靜，其實非常緊張。

ex.en: The apparent cause of the fire was faulty wiring.
ex.zh: 火災的起因看來是線路故障。

ex.en: She lives with him in a small apartment.
ex.zh: 她和他一起住在一間小公寓裡。

ex.en: How many rooms does she have in her apartment?
ex.zh: 她的公寓有幾個房間？

ex.en: I invited a Chinese friend to my apartment.
ex.zh: 我邀請了一位中國朋友來我的公寓。

ex.en: His speech won the immediate applause of the audience.
ex.zh: 他的演講立刻贏得了觀眾的掌聲。

ex.en: We gave the performer a round of applause.
ex.zh: 我們為表演者鼓掌。

ex.en: The portrait of the king was unveiled and received enthusiastic applause.
ex.zh: 國王的肖像揭幕時，獲得熱烈掌聲。

ex.en: I appreciate your help in clarifying this.
ex.zh: 謝謝你幫我把這件事說清楚。

ex.en: I deeply appreciate your advice and kindness.
ex.zh: 我非常感激你的建議和好意。

ex.en: Tom appreciates modern art.
ex.zh: 湯姆欣賞現代藝術。

ex.en: I hope Tom appreciates it.
ex.zh: 希望湯姆會懂得珍惜。

ex.en: The Japanese yen appreciated.
ex.zh: 日圓升值了。

ex.en: The Taiwanese dollar appreciated, causing Taiwanese exports to slump.
ex.zh: 新台幣升值，導致台灣出口下滑。

ex.en: I think that you ought to apologize to her.
ex.zh: 我認為你應該跟她道歉。

ex.en: He apologized to the teacher for coming to school late.
ex.zh: 他為上學遲到向老師道歉。

ex.en: Tom apologized for falling asleep in class.
ex.zh: 湯姆為自己上課睡著而道歉。

ex.en: We ordered spring rolls as an appetizer.
ex.zh: 我們點了春捲當開胃菜。

ex.en: The appetizers came out before the main course.
ex.zh: 開胃菜在主菜之前上桌。

ex.en: I have an appointment with him at six.
ex.zh: 我約了他六點見面。

ex.en: I made an appointment to see him at seven o'clock.
ex.zh: 我跟他約好七點見面。

ex.en: He canceled the appointment at the last moment.
ex.zh: 他在最後一刻取消了約。

ex.en: I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Lin.
ex.zh: 我想預約林醫師的門診。

ex.en: She announced the appointment of a new manager.
ex.zh: 她宣布任命一位新經理。

ex.en: His appointment as ambassador was approved.
ex.zh: 他的大使任命獲得批准。

ex.en: This is an appliance for drying clothes.
ex.zh: 這是用來烘乾衣服的器具。

ex.en: The apartment comes with all major appliances.
ex.zh: 這間公寓附有所有主要家電。

ex.en: Mary got the nod from among some 500 applicants.
ex.zh: 瑪麗從大約 500 名應徵者中脫穎而出。

ex.en: Does the applicant have suitable abilities to carry out the job?
ex.zh: 這位應徵者有能力勝任這份工作嗎？

ex.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
ex.zh: 這個職位要求應徵者具備良好的英語口說能力。

ex.en: I have my annual appraisal next week.
ex.zh: 我下週有年度考核。

ex.en: The appraisal showed that she needs more training.
ex.zh: 考核結果顯示她需要更多訓練。

ex.en: We need an appraisal of the house before selling it.
ex.zh: 賣房子前我們需要先估價。

ex.en: The jeweler gave us an appraisal of the ring.
ex.zh: 珠寶商幫我們鑑定了這枚戒指的價值。

ex.en: I am waiting for approval.
ex.zh: 我在等核准。

ex.en: He gave me his stamp of approval.
ex.zh: 他正式批准了我。

ex.en: The plan needs approval from the board.
ex.zh: 這個計畫需要董事會核准。

ex.en: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
ex.zh: 如果您同意，我想把這份工作給他。

ex.en: Tom nodded approval.
ex.zh: 湯姆點頭表示贊同。

ex.en: Approximately thirty young people attended.
ex.zh: 約有三十個年輕人到了。

ex.en: Tom fell approximately 30 meters.
ex.zh: 湯姆摔落了大約 30 公尺。

ex.en: Sami called at approximately six.
ex.zh: 薩米大約六點打來。

ex.en: The boss has already approved of our plans.
ex.zh: 老闆已經批准了我們的計劃。

ex.en: That four-year plan has to be approved.
ex.zh: 那個四年計畫必須經過核准。

ex.en: The manager approved our plan.
ex.zh: 經理批准了我們的計劃。

ex.en: Do you approve of what he is doing?
ex.zh: 你贊成他正在做的事嗎？

ex.en: That's why I don't approve of your plan.
ex.zh: 這就是我不贊成你計畫的原因。

ex.en: Tom is thinking about applying for a better-paying job.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在考慮應徵一份薪水更好的工作。

ex.en: I haven't decided which job to apply for.
ex.zh: 我還沒決定要應徵哪份工作。

ex.en: When applying to American universities, your TOEFL score is only one factor.
ex.zh: 申請美國大學時，托福成績只是其中一項考量。

ex.en: This kind of medicine can only be applied externally.
ex.zh: 這種藥物只能外用。

ex.en: Apply sunscreen before you go outside.
ex.zh: 出門前先擦防曬乳。

ex.en: This still applies to him.
ex.zh: 這點對他仍然適用。

ex.en: These rules apply to all visitors.
ex.zh: 這些規定適用於所有訪客。

ex.en: The due date for submitting the application is this Friday.
ex.zh: 申請截止日是這個星期五。

ex.en: We've received a lot of applications in answer to our advertisements.
ex.zh: 我們的徵人廣告已經收到很多應徵申請。

ex.en: Tom filled out the job application form.
ex.zh: 湯姆填好了求職申請表。

ex.en: The cellphone came with several applications already pre-installed.
ex.zh: 這支手機出廠時就預先安裝了幾個應用程式。

ex.en: This application lets you track your expenses.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式可以記錄你的花費。

ex.en: He has a remarkable aptitude for music.
ex.zh: 他有非凡的音樂天分。

ex.en: She shows a natural aptitude for languages.
ex.zh: 她很有語言天分。
